orchestrator.description: Evaluates findings, encodes verified output, decides next target

worker.description: Investigates targets, processes findings, produces raw output

steps.label: Observe
steps.description: Investigate the current target. Write findings to context/. Update context/status.md.

steps.label: Process
steps.description: Verify and refine observations. Produce output candidates. Update context/status.md.

steps.label: Encode
steps.description: Review processed output. Encode what's valuable into permanent form. Decide next target. Update context/status.md.
